blocks.en: Learning Goal

blocks.en: After studying this unit you will be familiar with the lives and ministries of seven great evangelistic preachers from church history. You will identify key characteristics that made their evangelistic preaching effective and be able to apply practical lessons to your own preaching and ministry.
blocks.es_reference: Después de estudiar esta unidad estará familiarizado con las vidas y ministerios de siete grandes predicadores evangelísticos de la historia de la iglesia. Identificará las características clave que hicieron efectiva su predicación evangelística y podrá aplicar lecciones prácticas a su propia predicación y ministerio.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.es_reference: Introducción

blocks.en: Throughout the history of the church God has raised up powerful evangelistic preachers who called people to repentance and faith in Christ. Their ministries often shook cities and nations. In this chapter we will briefly examine the backgrounds of seven outstanding evangelistic preachers — Girolamo Savonarola, John Knox, John Wesley, George Whitefield, Charles Finney, Dwight L. Moody, and Billy Graham — and discover the characteristics that made their preaching so effective. We will draw practical lessons we can apply today as we seek to proclaim the gospel with power.
blocks.es_reference: A lo largo de la historia de la iglesia, Dios ha levantado poderosos predicadores evangelísticos que llamaron a las personas al arrepentimiento y a la fe en Cristo. Sus ministerios a menudo sacudieron ciudades y naciones. En este capítulo examinaremos brevemente los antecedentes de siete destacados predicadores evangelísticos — Girolamo Savonarola, John Knox, John Wesley, George Whitefield, Charles Finney, Dwight L. Moody y Billy Graham — y descubriremos las características que hicieron tan efectiva su predicación. Extraeremos lecciones prácticas que podemos aplicar hoy mientras buscamos proclamar el evangelio con poder.

blocks.en: Girolamo Savonarola (1452–1498)
blocks.es_reference: Girolamo Savonarola (1452–1498)

blocks.en: Girolamo Savonarola was an Italian Dominican friar and preacher who became the spiritual leader of Florence during the Renaissance. Born in Ferrara, he entered the Dominican order and gained a reputation for bold, prophetic preaching against moral corruption in the church and society. He called for repentance and a return to biblical purity, predicting judgment on a sinful city. His sermons in the cathedral drew huge crowds and led to sweeping moral reforms in Florence. He clashed with corrupt rulers and Pope Alexander VI, ultimately being excommunicated and executed.
blocks.es_reference: Girolamo Savonarola fue un fraile dominico italiano y predicador que se convirtió en el líder espiritual de Florencia durante el Renacimiento. Nacido en Ferrara, ingresó en la orden dominica y ganó reputación por su predicación audaz y profética contra la corrupción moral en la iglesia y la sociedad. Llamó al arrepentimiento y al regreso a la pureza bíblica, prediciendo juicio sobre una ciudad pecadora. Sus sermones en la catedral atrajeron multitudes enormes y llevaron a reformas morales radicales en Florencia. Chocó con gobernantes corruptos y el papa Alejandro VI, siendo finalmente excomulgado y ejecutado.

blocks.en: Key characteristics
blocks.es_reference: Características clave

blocks.en: Fearless confrontation of sin and corruption, even at great personal cost.
blocks.es_reference: Confrontación intrépida del pecado y la corrupción, incluso a un gran costo personal.

blocks.en: Apocalyptic urgency that called hearers to immediate repentance.
blocks.es_reference: Urgencia apocalíptica que llamaba a los oyentes al arrepentimiento inmediato.

blocks.en: Powerful use of simple vernacular Italian instead of Latin, making the message accessible to ordinary people.
blocks.es_reference: Uso poderoso del italiano vernáculo simple en lugar del latín, haciendo el mensaje accesible a la gente común.

blocks.en: Expository preaching rooted in Scripture (especially the prophets and Revelation) that applied truth directly to daily life.
blocks.es_reference: Predicación expositiva arraigada en las Escrituras (especialmente los profetas y Apocalipsis) que aplicaba la verdad directamente a la vida diaria.

blocks.en: John Knox (c. 1514–1572)
blocks.es_reference: John Knox (c. 1514–1572)

blocks.en: John Knox was a Scottish Reformer and the leading figure in the Scottish Reformation. Originally a Catholic priest, he converted to Protestantism and became a bold preacher and writer. He served as chaplain to Edward VI in England, was imprisoned in France, and later studied with John Calvin in Geneva. Upon returning to Scotland he led the nation into Reformed faith and helped shape the Presbyterian Church. He preached long, passionate sermons emphasizing Scripture as the sole authority.
blocks.es_reference: John Knox fue un reformador escocés y la figura principal de la Reforma escocesa. Originalmente sacerdote católico, se convirtió al protestantismo y se convirtió en un predicador audaz y escritor. Sirvió como capellán de Eduardo VI en Inglaterra, fue encarcelado en Francia y luego estudió con Juan Calvino en Ginebra. Al regresar a Escocia lideró a la nación hacia la fe reformada y ayudó a dar forma a la Iglesia Presbiteriana. Predicaba sermones largos y apasionados que enfatizaban las Escrituras como la única autoridad.

blocks.en: Key characteristics
blocks.es_reference: Características clave

blocks.en: Uncompromising commitment to the authority of Scripture alone.
blocks.es_reference: Compromiso inquebrantable con la autoridad de las Escrituras solas.

blocks.en: Direct, personal application of the gospel that confronted hearers with their need for Christ.
blocks.es_reference: Aplicación directa y personal del evangelio que confrontaba a los oyentes con su necesidad de Cristo.

blocks.en: Courageous public preaching even under threat of persecution and exile.
blocks.es_reference: Predicación pública valiente incluso bajo amenaza de persecución y exilio.

blocks.en: Clear teaching on justification by faith alone that transformed lives and nations.
blocks.es_reference: Enseñanza clara sobre la justificación por la fe sola que transformó vidas y naciones.

blocks.en: John Wesley (1703–1791)
blocks.es_reference: John Wesley (1703–1791)

blocks.en: John Wesley was an Anglican clergyman and the founder of the Methodist movement. After a dramatic conversion experience he became an itinerant evangelist who preached in fields, streets, and open air to the working classes. He organized converts into small groups (societies and bands) for discipleship and holy living. He traveled over 250,000 miles and preached more than 40,000 sermons, emphasizing salvation by faith and the call to Christian perfection.
blocks.es_reference: John Wesley fue un clérigo anglicano y fundador del movimiento metodista. Después de una experiencia de conversión dramática se convirtió en evangelista itinerante que predicaba en campos, calles y al aire libre a las clases trabajadoras. Organizaba a los convertidos en pequeños grupos (sociedades y bandas) para el discipulado y la vida santa. Viajó más de 250.000 millas y predicó más de 40.000 sermones, enfatizando la salvación por la fe y el llamado a la perfección cristiana.

blocks.en: Key characteristics
blocks.es_reference: Características clave

blocks.en: Bold open-air preaching that reached the masses outside traditional churches.
blocks.es_reference: Predicación audaz al aire libre que alcanzaba a las masas fuera de las iglesias tradicionales.

blocks.en: Simple, clear message of salvation by faith in Christ alone.
blocks.es_reference: Mensaje simple y claro de salvación por la fe en Cristo solo.

blocks.en: Strong emphasis on personal holiness and disciplined Christian living.
blocks.es_reference: Fuerte énfasis en la santidad personal y la vida cristiana disciplinada.

blocks.en: Systematic follow-up through small groups that turned converts into mature disciples.
blocks.es_reference: Seguimiento sistemático a través de pequeños grupos que convertía a los convertidos en discípulos maduros.

blocks.en: George Whitefield (1714–1770)
blocks.es_reference: George Whitefield (1714–1770)

blocks.en: George Whitefield was an Anglican priest and one of the greatest open-air preachers of the Great Awakening. A friend of the Wesleys, he preached to massive crowds in Britain and America (often 20,000–30,000 people). He was known for his dramatic oratory, powerful voice, and emotional yet biblically grounded appeals. He helped spark revival on both sides of the Atlantic and influenced early American evangelicalism.
blocks.es_reference: George Whitefield fue un sacerdote anglicano y uno de los más grandes predicadores al aire libre del Gran Despertar. Amigo de los Wesley, predicó a multitudes masivas en Gran Bretaña y América (a menudo 20.000–30.000 personas). Era conocido por su oratoria dramática, voz poderosa y apelaciones emocionales pero fundamentadas en la Biblia. Ayudó a encender el avivamiento a ambos lados del Atlántico e influyó en el evangelicalismo estadounidense temprano.

blocks.en: Key characteristics
blocks.es_reference: Características clave

blocks.en: Dramatic, passionate delivery that captured the heart as well as the mind.
blocks.es_reference: Entrega dramática y apasionada que capturaba el corazón además de la mente.

blocks.en: Massive open-air meetings that reached thousands who never entered churches.
blocks.es_reference: Reuniones masivas al aire libre que alcanzaban a miles que nunca entraban en las iglesias.

blocks.en: Clear emphasis on the new birth and personal conversion.
blocks.es_reference: Enfoque claro en el nuevo nacimiento y la conversión personal.

blocks.en: Tireless itinerant ministry across two continents without regard for denominational barriers.
blocks.es_reference: Ministerio itinerante incansable en dos continentes sin importar barreras denominacionales.

blocks.en: Charles Finney (1792–1875)
blocks.es_reference: Charles Finney (1792–1875)

blocks.en: Charles Grandison Finney was an American lawyer-turned-evangelist known as the "father of modern revivalism." Converted after intense study of the Bible, he began holding revivals in upstate New York. He introduced "new measures" such as the anxious bench and public prayer by name. His logical, direct preaching style led to thousands of conversions and social reforms.
blocks.es_reference: Charles Grandison Finney fue un abogado estadounidense convertido en evangelista, conocido como el "padre del avivamiento moderno". Convertido después de un intenso estudio de la Biblia, comenzó a realizar avivamientos en el norte de Nueva York. Introdujo "nuevas medidas" como el banco de los ansiosos y la oración pública por nombre. Su estilo de predicación lógico y directo llevó a miles de conversiones y reformas sociales.

blocks.en: Key characteristics
blocks.es_reference: Características clave

blocks.en: Direct, personal address that confronted individuals with their sin and need for Christ.
blocks.es_reference: Interpelación directa y personal que confrontaba a los individuos con su pecado y necesidad de Cristo.

blocks.en: Logical, lawyer-like reasoning that made the gospel clear and compelling.
blocks.es_reference: Razonamiento lógico y estilo de abogado que hacía el evangelio claro y convincente.

blocks.en: Innovative methods (the anxious bench, immediate decision) that called for public response.
blocks.es_reference: Métodos innovadores (el banco de los ansiosos, la decisión inmediata) que llamaban a una respuesta pública.

blocks.en: Expectation of immediate conversion and visible life change.
blocks.es_reference: Expectativa de conversión inmediata y cambio visible de vida.

blocks.en: Dwight L. Moody (1837–1899)
blocks.es_reference: Dwight L. Moody (1837–1899)

blocks.en: Dwight Lyman Moody was a former shoe salesman who became one of the most influential evangelists of the nineteenth century. He conducted large urban campaigns in America and Britain, often working with singer Ira Sankey. Moody founded churches, schools, and Moody Bible Institute. His simple, heartfelt preaching emphasized the love of God and the need for personal decision.
blocks.es_reference: Dwight Lyman Moody fue un ex vendedor de zapatos que se convirtió en uno de los evangelistas más influyentes del siglo XIX. Realizó grandes campañas urbanas en América y Gran Bretaña, a menudo trabajando con el cantante Ira Sankey. Moody fundó iglesias, escuelas y el Instituto Bíblico Moody. Su predicación simple y sincera enfatizaba el amor de Dios y la necesidad de una decisión personal.

blocks.en: Key characteristics
blocks.es_reference: Características clave

blocks.en: Simple, straightforward gospel presentation anyone could understand.
blocks.es_reference: Presentación simple y directa del evangelio que cualquiera podía entender.

blocks.en: Use of gospel music and large organized campaigns to reach cities.
blocks.es_reference: Uso de música gospel y campañas organizadas a gran escala para alcanzar ciudades.

blocks.en: Strong emphasis on the love of Christ and practical Christian living.
blocks.es_reference: Fuerte énfasis en el amor de Cristo y la vida cristiana práctica.

blocks.en: Commitment to follow-up and training new believers through institutions.
blocks.es_reference: Compromiso con el seguimiento y la formación de nuevos creyentes a través de instituciones.

blocks.en: Billy Graham (1918–2018)
blocks.es_reference: Billy Graham (1918–2018)

blocks.en: Billy Graham was the most widely heard evangelist in history. Through crusades, radio, television, and global missions he preached to more than 200 million people in over 185 countries. His simple message — "the Bible says" — called people to repent and trust Christ. He maintained personal integrity and worked across denominational lines.
blocks.es_reference: Billy Graham fue el evangelista más ampliamente escuchado de la historia. A través de cruzadas, radio, televisión y misiones globales predicó a más de 200 millones de personas en más de 185 países. Su mensaje simple — "la Biblia dice" — llamaba a las personas a arrepentirse y confiar en Cristo. Mantuvo integridad personal y trabajó a través de líneas denominacionales.

blocks.en: Key characteristics
blocks.es_reference: Características clave

blocks.en: Simple, biblical message focused on sin, the cross, and salvation.
blocks.es_reference: Mensaje simple y bíblico centrado en el pecado, la cruz y la salvación.

blocks.en: Massive, well-organized crusades using modern media.
blocks.es_reference: Cruzadas masivas y bien organizadas que usaban medios modernos.

blocks.en: Clear, urgent call for personal decision and commitment to Christ.
blocks.es_reference: Llamado claro y urgente a la decisión personal y el compromiso con Cristo.

blocks.en: Consistent personal integrity and humility that earned widespread respect.
blocks.es_reference: Integridad personal constante y humildad que ganó respeto generalizado.

blocks.en: Common Threads Across the Centuries
blocks.es_reference: Hilos Comunes a Través de los Siglos

blocks.en: Five hundred years separate Savonarola's cathedral in Florence from Billy Graham's stadium crusades, yet several threads run through every one of these ministries. Each man preached a biblical gospel centered on the cross and the resurrection. Each called for personal repentance and immediate decision. Each spoke the language of ordinary people rather than the language of the academy. Each was willing to pay a price — some with their lives, others with their reputations — for the privilege of proclaiming Christ. And each was concerned not only that people decide, but that converts be followed up and matured in the faith. The styles differed; the methods adapted to each century; but the heart was the same. That heart is the lasting model for any preacher who wants to see lost men and women come home to God.
blocks.es_reference: Quinientos años separan la catedral de Savonarola en Florencia de las cruzadas de estadio de Billy Graham, sin embargo varios hilos recorren cada uno de estos ministerios. Cada hombre predicó un evangelio bíblico centrado en la cruz y la resurrección. Cada uno llamó al arrepentimiento personal y a la decisión inmediata. Cada uno habló el idioma de la gente común en lugar del idioma de la academia. Cada uno estuvo dispuesto a pagar un precio — algunos con sus vidas, otros con sus reputaciones — por el privilegio de proclamar a Cristo. Y cada uno se preocupó no solo de que las personas decidieran, sino de que los convertidos fueran seguidos y madurados en la fe. Los estilos diferían; los métodos se adaptaban a cada siglo; pero el corazón era el mismo. Ese corazón es el modelo duradero para cualquier predicador que quiera ver a los hombres y mujeres perdidos volver a casa con Dios.

sa.prompt: Name the seven great evangelistic preachers studied in this unit.
sa.model: The seven great evangelistic preachers studied are Girolamo Savonarola, John Knox, John Wesley, George Whitefield, Charles Finney, D. L. Moody, and Billy Graham.

sa.prompt: Where did Savonarola minister, and what was the cost of his fearless preaching against corruption?
sa.model: Savonarola ministered in Florence, where he preached fearlessly against corruption. The cost was severe: he was excommunicated by the pope and ultimately executed, paying for his bold preaching with his life.

sa.prompt: What did John Knox lead in Scotland, and what doctrinal teaching transformed lives and nations through his ministry?
sa.model: John Knox led the Scottish Reformation. His preaching of justification by faith and the authority of Scripture transformed lives and the nation, shaping the Presbyterian church in Scotland.

sa.prompt: How did John Wesley's small-group strategy (societies and bands) fit alongside his open-air evangelism?
sa.model: Wesley paired open-air evangelistic preaching with a small-group strategy of societies and bands. The open-air preaching reached the crowds; the small groups discipled and matured new converts, providing the follow-up that made the fruit last.

sa.prompt: What made George Whitefield's preaching reach so many thousands of people?
sa.model: Whitefield's preaching reached thousands through powerful open-air preaching, a dramatic and passionate delivery, and a remarkable voice. As an itinerant he crossed continents and broke through barriers, calling crowds to the new birth.

sa.prompt: What were Charles Finney's 'new measures,' and what expectation drove his preaching?
sa.model: Finney's 'new measures' included the anxious bench, public prayer, and calling people by name. They were driven by his expectation of immediate, visible conversion and decision, and of real life change as the proof of it.

sa.prompt: How did D. L. Moody combine simplicity of message with large-scale organization?
sa.model: Moody combined a simple, straightforward gospel message with large-scale organization: gospel music with Ira Sankey, well-organized urban campaigns, careful follow-up, and lasting institutions like his Bible institute.

sa.prompt: What was Billy Graham's signature phrase in his preaching, and how did he approach denominational lines?
sa.model: Billy Graham's signature phrase was 'the Bible says.' He worked across denominational lines, approaching cooperation with integrity and humility while keeping the gospel message simple.

sa.prompt: Choose any one of the seven preachers and describe one practical lesson you would apply to your own evangelistic ministry.
sa.model: A good answer names any one of the seven preachers and draws one practical lesson to apply to one's own preaching and ministry - for example, Wesley's follow-up through small groups, or Graham's simple, Bible-centered gospel - tying it to faithfully proclaiming Christ.

sa.prompt: What common threads run through all seven preachers' ministries, according to the closing synthesis of this unit?
sa.model: Common threads run through all seven: a biblical, cross-centered gospel calling for repentance and decision, preaching in ordinary language people understood, a willingness to pay a price, and attention to follow-up so converts matured.
